topic: Second cyclone in a week: *120 kmph* sto
hook: Bay system now a *deep depression*; 'Murasu' due within hours
hook_b: Travelling to coastal Andhra this week? Landfall is due *Nov 3*
tldr: IMD: the Bay depression has become a deep depression; landfall as a severe cyclonic storm Nov 3, Nellore–Narsapur.

beats.what: A Bay of Bengal depression is set to become a severe cyclonic storm by Nov 2.
beats.why: A low-pressure area formed over the south Andaman Sea on Oct 29 and keeps strengthening.
beats.care: Trips to coastal AP Nov 2–3? Check train and bus status before leaving.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Update, Nov 1 midday: the depression has intensified into a deep depression over the Bay of Bengal (The Hindu). IMD says it may become cyclonic storm 'Murasu' within about six hours, and a severe cyclonic storm over the westcentral Bay on Nov 2 (Hindustan Times). It is likely to cross the AP coast between Nellore and Narsapur on Nov 3, at 100–110 kmph gusting 120 kmph. HT also reports a heavy rain alert for Andhra and Tamil Nadu till Nov 3. Earlier: APSDMA flagged heavy to very heavy rain on Nov 2 in Eluru, West Godavari, NTR, Krishna, Guntur, Bapatla, Palnadu, Prakasam, Markapuram, Nellore and Tirupati; fishermen told to stay off the sea Nov 2–4.

cards.q: Two cyclones in a week: what worries you most?
Where is the cyclone expected to cross the coast?
cards.why: IMD's bulletin puts landfall between Narsapur and Nellore early on Nov 3.

viz.l: AP districts on heavy-rain watch, Nov 2

insight: It comes just days after Cyclone Arnab hit the Kakinada–Narsapur coast on Oct 27–28.
watch: IMD bulletins every few hours; the exact landfall point can shift.
